purpose: Use the extracted fixed direction readers to choose per-condition interpolation gains that prospectively achieve a specified signed causal margin edit.
data_status: SECOND-CORPUS TEXT AND BINARY LATTICE OPEN; all reader-chosen fractional-gain interventions are new and remain unopened

binding_prediction.selection: All and only conditions with abs(fixed_reader_q)>=0.05; 278 total, 156 plural-to-singular, 122 singular-to-plural; 126 above_inside, 152 inside_above.

binding_validation.finding: Fixed readers prospectively predict the full lattice with perfect signs and beat swapped readers.

novelty_audit: Searches for reader-guided edit, target-margin reader, closed-loop margin head edit, and fixed-reader manipulation found no prior event.
Prior continuous-gain work evaluates prechosen gains. This test uses the extracted reader to compute a gain for a specified behavioral target.
map: For each frozen supported row/background, desired=0.04*sign(q_hat), alpha=desired/q_hat. Frozen alpha lies in [0.12167,0.79893]. Install h_guided=h_base+alpha(h_exact-h_base). Measure q_guided=margin(h_guided)-margin(h_base). A fixed alpha=0.5 edit on the same support is the matched control. No observed fractional-gain outcome enters selection or gain.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_frozen_support: All hashes/closures pass; exactly 278 unique supported conditions and gains match the sealed formula; all gains are in (0,0.8].
predictions.pred_b_reader_guided_edit_hits_target: Guided edits have sign agreement >=0.98, median absolute target error <=0.015, and 90th-percentile absolute error <=0.03.
predictions.pred_c_both_directions_hit_target: Each direction has sign agreement >=0.95 and median absolute target error <=0.02.
predictions.pred_d_both_templates_hit_target: Each template has sign agreement >=0.95 and median absolute target error <=0.02.
predictions.pred_e_reader_guidance_beats_fixed_gain: Guided edits reduce mean absolute error to the desired target at least 30% versus alpha=0.5 on identical support.
predictions.pred_f_no_target_outcome_calibration: Selection and alpha use only the pre-causal sealed q_hat; no observed fractional-gain effect, fitted scale, offset, or endpoint calibration enters the edit.

null: Failure of b-d means the extracted reader predicts sign/composition but cannot set an absolute intervention target. Failure of e means a generic half edit is equally useful. Preserve all new fractional-gain outcomes; no threshold or gain retuning.
